description: Co-conservation of the E3.29/R7.41 pair across nematode homologues and the pocket-position comparison table
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
O=pd.read_csv("dcar1_ortholog_bw_positions.csv")
n=len(O)
pairc=((O['3.29|E113']=='E')&(O['7.41|R300']=='R')).sum()
print(f"homologues analysed: {n}")
print(f"E at 3.29 and R at 7.41 together: {pairc}/{n}")
for c in ['3.29|E113','3.36|F120','7.41|R300','7.43|F302','3.32|F116','6.48|M266']:
    print(f"  {c:12s} " + ", ".join(f"{a}:{b}" for a,b in O[c].value_counts().items()))
sub=O[(O['3.29|E113']!='E')|(O['7.41|R300']!='R')][['acc','organism','pid','3.29|E113','7.41|R300']]
print("\nexceptions:"); print(sub.to_string(index=False) if len(sub) else " none")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
pos=['3.29','3.32','3.33','3.36','6.48','7.39','7.41','7.43']
cols=['3.29|E113','3.32|F116','3.33|I117','3.36|F120','6.48|M266','7.39|C298','7.41|R300','7.43|F302']
frac=[ (O[c]==O[c].iloc[0]).mean()*100 for c in cols ]
ref=[c.split("|")[1][0] for c in cols]
bars=ax[0].bar(range(len(pos)),frac,color=['#2ca02c' if r in 'RK' else '#d62728' if r in 'DE' else '#7f7f7f' for r in ref])
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(pos)));ax[0].set_xticklabels([f"{p}\n{r}" for p,r in zip(pos,ref)])
ax[0].set_ylabel(f"% of {n} nematode homologues keeping the C. elegans residue")
ax[0].set_title("Pocket-position conservation in DCAR-1 homologues")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,105);ax[0].grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)
comp=pd.DataFrame({"position":["3.29","3.32","3.33","3.36","7.39","7.41","7.43"],
 "HCAR2":["L","F","A","R","L","S","Y"],"HCAR3":["L","F","A","R","L","S","Y"],
 "DCAR-1":["E","F","I","F","C","R","F"]}).set_index("position")
ax[1].axis('off')
tb=ax[1].table(cellText=comp.values,rowLabels=comp.index,colLabels=comp.columns,loc='center',cellLoc='center')
tb.scale(1,1.9);tb.set_fontsize(12)
for i,p in enumerate(comp.index):
    for j in range(3):
        c=tb[(i+1,j)]
        if comp.values[i,j] in 'RK': c.set_facecolor('#c7e9c0')
        if comp.values[i,j] in 'DE': c.set_facecolor('#fcbba1')
ax[1].set_title("Residues at the carboxylate-anchor positions\n(green basic, red acidic)")
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
